# narration mode

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:narrationMode`](gmeow-narrationMode.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/narrationMode>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/narrative`](../../slices/narrative.md)

The mode(s) of this narration usage. At least one (SHACL): if you reified, you had a reason. NOT functional: a flashback can also be a dream; coexisting critical readings ride the statement layer ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).
